label: Minnie Mouse
description: Sweet, polite and bright as a polka-dot bow.
direction: Speak high, sweet and bright, in Minnie's gentle falsetto: warm, polite, a little giggly, never sharp. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. Sweetness and catchphrases live on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Steamboat Willie and later Disney cartoons
rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (character created by Walt Disney and Ub Iwerks)
rights.pd_basis: Partial at most. The 1928 Steamboat Willie version of the character entered the US public domain in 2024, but that silent-era Minnie barely spoke; the voice a clone would copy is the later, still-copyrighted performance, and Minnie Mouse remains a live Disney trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.
